faqs.question: What is included in the DIGENZ web development packages?
faqs.answer: All our web packages include custom responsive frontend design, modern mobile-first styling, lead generation forms, clean semantic code, basic on-page SEO, source code ownership, and 30-90 days of technical support.

faqs.question: How fast can DIGENZ deliver a new project?
faqs.answer: Logo packages are delivered within 24 to 48 hours. Standard 5-page websites take 3 to 7 business days, while enterprise web applications and custom ecommerce portals take 2 to 4 weeks depending on specifications.

faqs.question: Do I own 100% of the rights to the designs and source code?
faqs.answer: Yes! Upon final approval and project completion, 100% full commercial copyright, source code, and design assets belong entirely to you with no hidden licensing fees.

faqs.question: What is the DIGENZ refund policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If initial concepts do not align with your design brief before subsequent revision cycles, you are eligible for a prompt refund per our Refund Policy.

privacy.summary: DIGENZ respects your personal privacy. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal or financial information to third parties. All client communications and project files are encrypted and confidential.

terms.summary: By engaging DIGENZ services, clients agree to accurate project briefs, prompt milestone feedback, and adherence to service payment schedules. All delivered custom assets become client property upon final payment settlement.

refund.summary: Clients may request revisions or a refund prior to approving final project deliverables. Once source files are delivered or deployed to live production servers, project milestones are considered accepted.
